definitions: A hierarchy in a group, especially one based on social status or power.
The system of social organization in a group of chickens, in which each bird has a rank determining its access to food and mates.
examples: There's a clear pecking order in the office.
She's at the bottom of the pecking order.
The new employee quickly learned the pecking order.
The pecking order among the siblings was evident.
He tried to disrupt the established pecking order.
